skills.name: Overhead Slam
skills.note: Your #1 damage source; with Rage Burst and Lunge Stance it's effectively always up. 16 removes the cooldown, 20 adds the guaranteed crit.

skills.name: Rending Blow
skills.note: Second-biggest damage and your mana engine. Mobile pick at 8, +50 MP on crit at 16, +12% single target at 20.

skills.name: Ruinous Blow
skills.note: Big nuke that grants Prepare for Battle (+20% PvE damage, 20s).

skills.name: Sword Aura Rampage
skills.note: Only hits Staggered targets; at 16 every hit takes 1s off all cooldowns, stigmas included.

skills.name: Leaping Slam
skills.note: Main gap-closer; 3s of Prepare for Battle before Ruinous Blow extends it.

skills.name: Rush Strike
skills.note: Dodge into a gap-close. Take the Stamina pick over -10s cooldown.

skills.name: Mocking Blade
skills.note: Emergency heal: 15% HP absorbed from bosses.

skills.name: Ankle Slice
skills.note: Backup closer. Skip the Ankle Smash chain.

skills.name: Crushing Wave
skills.note: Too slow for bosses; AoE and self-heal on trash.

skills.name: Keen Strike
skills.note: Basic attack: +20% MP and -1s Ruinous Blow cooldown per hit. Stop holding it once Overhead Slam and Rending Blow are 16.

skills.name: Aerial Snare
skills.note: Optional, bosses only (aLuckyRO): +100% damage to CC-immune targets and the Forced Fall chain. Give it its own key.

skills.name: Defiance
skills.note: CC break, only if you have points to spare.

stigmas.name: Lunge Stance
stigmas.note: Level 20 cuts all cooldowns on crits. First stigma to max.

stigmas.name: Focused Block
stigmas.note: Guaranteed parry; every block triggers Experienced Counterstrike's party buff. Two uses in a row at 5.

stigmas.name: Rage Burst
stigmas.note: Triggers Overhead Slam for 10s, +10% PvE Damage Boost, -10% boss Attack; -15s cooldown at 5.

stigmas.name: Zikel's Blessing
stigmas.note: Default 4th slot: +20% Attack, +10% PvE Damage Boost at 10.

stigmas.name: Lifestealing Blade
stigmas.note: Replaces Zikel's Blessing: Predation on the party. Only worth it at 20. Blade Toss (-30% boss Defense) is the semi-tank alternative.

passives.name: Attack Preparation
passives.note: Flat PvE Damage Boost, Defense and Accuracy. No conditions.

passives.name: Experienced Counterstrike
passives.note: Front damage at all times, plus a 20s party PvE Damage Boost on every block.

passives.name: Murderous Burst
passives.note: Every 5 hits: AoE burst + crit damage.

passives.name: Destructive Impulse
passives.note: Bonus damage on Staggered targets; after the main passives.

passives.name: Protection Armor
passives.note: Trap: reroll gear and cards that roll it.

arcana.Chalice: Vigor — whatever is still short of 20
arcana.Set: 4-piece Primal Vigor; 2-piece Magic Armor only if MP runs dry

stats.note: Ludra raid wants at least 1,000 Accuracy.
Ludra raid wants at least 1,000 Critical Hit.

daevanionNote: Guide priority: blue nodes for Overhead Slam, Rending Blow and Ruinous Blow first, then the orange nodes, then stats. Azphel is PvP only.

ludra.name: Abyssal Forge: Ludra
ludra.note: 10-player Sanctuary raid, four level-75 bosses. Entry needs level 45 and item level 2,800; groups usually also ask for a combat-power number.
ludra.warning: The raid was temporarily removed after Early Access and returns on November 4, 2026.

phases.title: Finish the level phase
do: Main story to 45; item level 1,000 is needed to finish the story (Abyss visit).
Side quests, sealed dungeons (map '?'), strongholds and the 5 daily quests.
Weapon to about +10; amulet +10 and morph it blue.

phases.title: Permanent upgrades first
do: Belt: stronghold scrolls to +10, then craft it up to legendary — it never gets replaced.
Revelation Amulet: feathers from the world and the Abyss at the monolith, same idea.
Regional quests for accessories, runes and titles; clash runes only to +1.
Daevanion: sealed dungeons and regional quests give the crystals; Krao Cave and Draupnir open at 700.
Shugo Festival, rifts, daily dungeons.

phases.title: Farm Vakron Sky Island / Urugugu Canyon
do: Conquest tier with item-level-70 Unique gear — take the chest piece last to skip the grind for the final slot.
Never skip Nightmare entries and the Ascension Trial each reset (normal difficulty from 1,500).
If a few points are missing: enhance the bracelets, they stay with you a long time.

phases.title: Transcendence and the first Arcana set
do: Transcendence Stage 1 (Deus Research Base, Shattered Arkanis): plain Arcana cards are worth 20 item level each, green ones 40.
Fill the remaining Abyss feathers at the monolith; buy Daevanion crystals from the Nightmare and Shugo shops.
Level the cards to 10; Overhead Slam and Ruinous Blow on the Parchment first.

phases.title: Fire Temple / Ferocious Horn Den
do: Conquest tier with item-level-86 gear; the Fire Temple weapons are the interesting part.
Transcendence Stage 2 for blue Arcana cards, then unique Arcana crafting.
Re-roll bad random lines (Evasion, resists) into Might, Combat Speed, Precision; fill every manastone slot.

phases.title: Last stretch
do: Ascension Trial Extreme (2,500) and the Hard modes of Krao Cave and Draupnir (2,600) — the Ariel board fragments drop there.
Enhance every slot evenly: the cheapest item level is usually the lowest piece, not the weapon.
Season shop: Talisra Wings (about 250,000 points); titles Guardian of Baran or Artguard; pets to 3 and Genus Insight rolls.

phases.title: Raid-ready
do: Ludra weapons (item level 102, max +15) drop from Eternal Ludra; the Unique armor and accessories have 4 manastone slots.
Keep a second stigma preset with Lifestealing Blade 20 for organized parties.
